166768003.title: File:Coca-Cola AI ad - truck with misspelled logo.png

ImageDescription.value: Screenshot from the AI-assisted Coca-Cola holiday commercial "Silver Santa". This frame is an AI-generated image of a red truck trailer with a distorted version of the Coca-Cola logo misspelled as "Coca-Coola", awkwardly placed on the rear corner of the trailer, above the wheel and underride guard. The logo is too small and incorrectly positioned—it would typically span the full side of the trailer, but here appears partially cut off and poorly placed. While the ad campaign as a whole involved significant human authorship (e.g. 3D rigging for bottle shots, manual arrangement of clips, live choral music), and the logo was manually edited onto the trucks in other clips used in the video ads, this particular frame appears to be an uncorrected output from generative AI. The logo error and compositional flaws suggest that no human intervention or post-processing was applied to this image. Accordingly, it likely does not meet the threshold of originality required for copyright protection under U.S. law. (Reference: "A Behind-the-Scenes Look at Coke's AI Commercial")

Artist.value:
Silverside AI for The Coca-Cola Company

AI technologies used in the ad campaign include: Leonardo, Luma, Runway, Kling, Sora (OpenAI), and Minimax.

136630113.title: File:Vintage Coca-Cola delivery truck at the Biedenharn Museum & Gardens in Monroe Louisiana.jpg

ImageDescription.value: A vintage Coca-Cola delivery truck at the Biedenharn Museum & Gardens in Monroe, a city in northeast Louisiana and the seat of the state’s Ouachita (pronounded WAH-shi-taw) Parish.  (Louisiana calls its counties “parishes.”)  The Biedenharn is a multifaceted museum complex that features scheduled exhibits, a multitude of events, and mini-museums including one about the Bible and this one about the Coca-Cola soft drink.
